Mission.eyebrow: Yɛayɛ ama asɛmpatrɛw wɔ wiase nyinaa
Mission.headline: Asɛm no nsesa. Nanso ɔkwan a nnipa fa so hwɛ no sesa.
Mission.intro: Yɛresan asi yɛn video nhomakorabea ne yɛn nnwinnade fi fapem, na yɛde mfe pii nkyerɛase adwuma rekɔ baabi a nnipa ahyia dedaw, hwɛ nneɛma, na wɔkyekyɛ.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Sini nhomakorabea a wɔakyerɛ ase kɛse sen biara wɔ wiase
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Mfe pii nkyerɛase adwuma a asɛmpa adwuma mu mmoafo a wogye wɔn di ayɛ no asi nhomakorabea a kasa mpempem wom, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nnipa bɛte Yesu ho asɛm wɔ kasa a ɛka wɔn koma kɛse mu.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Yɛde nne a wogye di rekɔ akwan foforo so
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Yɛresan ayɛ ɔkwan a yɛfa so de mfonini ka asɛmpa mu nsɛm, de nkyerɛase a wogye di ne nnɛ akwan abom, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a asɛm no betumi akɔ beae biara, amammerɛ biara ne screen biara so a biribi nsiw kwan.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Ɛnyɛ nhomakorabea kɛkɛ. Ɛyɛ kuw a asɛmpatrɛw na ɛkanyan wɔn.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project yɛ kuw a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa, a nkyerɛasefo, media ho animdefo, nsɛm nhwɛsofo ne adeyɛfo wom, a wɔde mfe pii asɛmpa adwuma mu osuahu reyɛ nnwinnade ama asuafo-yɛfo wɔ baabiara.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Ɛde wɔn a wɔhwɛ no ka hokwan ankasa ahorow ho wɔ wɔn honhom mu akwantu mu, na ɛboa wɔn ma wɔtu anammɔn a edi hɔ kɔ mpɔtam nnipa, Kyerɛwsɛm, anaa asɛmpatrɛw mu.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Kristofo media nhomakorabea kɛse a video, sini ne mmoa mpempem wom wɔ kasa ahorow mu, ma asɛmpa adwuma ne asɛmpaka wɔ wiase nyinaa.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Video nhwɛso, nsɛm kyekyɛ, atiefo ne wɔn ntam nkitahodi, ne akontaabu a wɔayɛ de aboa asɛmpa nnwuma ma wɔadu nnipa pii so yiye.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Boa ma yɛnyɛ asɛmpatrɛw nnwinnade a ɛyɛ {accent}
Mission.inviteBody: Yɛrefrɛ adwumayɛfo, adeyɛfo ne mmoafo sɛ wɔmmra mfi ase ntɛm. Sɔ nnwinnade foforo hwɛ kan, ka w’adwene, na boa ma yɛnyɛ nneɛma a ɛfata asɛmpatrɛw adwuma ankasa.
